scope: Automatic fitting and explicit electrical insertion of reviewed devboard headers into a configurable breadboard; local source and versioned build verification.
fitRules: All insertion leads align with distinct free terminal holes
Calibrated positive X/Y scales shared by artwork and all contacts
Exact physical pitch and row spacing on the breadboard grid
No two separate leads may share a terminal strip
No overlapping seated module envelopes on one host
Power rails and auxiliary/programming/rear-view contacts excluded from insertion
transactions: Immutable preview and one undo step on drop
Explicit attachment edges without hidden wires or overlap inference
Independent movement/rotation detaches; fitted scale retained
Moving a stale guest cannot detach a stationary neighbor

checks: Native library drag previews a fitted Pico without changing history, then commits forty contacts atomically.
Every rendered pad center coincides with both its transformed endpoint and exact breadboard hole.
One undo removes the module and all forty connections; redo restores them.
Covered breadboard targets stay behind the PCB: clicking and dragging its body selects and moves the module without starting a wire.
Dragging an existing attached module previews a new fit; Escape discards the fit without changing the drawing.
Mounted geometry exports to SVG/PNG and round-trips through the saved project format.
Rotating the breadboard carries the fitted module while preserving all forty electrical contacts.
Dragging away detaches all contacts in one undoable edit and retains the fitted visual scale.
390px native touch body drag previews and commits a complete forty-contact fit.
Touch placement uses one undo step and restores the exact original serialized project.
A second touch cancels the placement preview, leaves no attachment edit and releases the gesture.

visualReview.notes: Mounted PCB hides underlying host contact targets. Its own contacts and all wires remain visible. Fit status is clear of rotation controls.

whitespace: git diff --check and changed/untracked text whitespace scan passed
artifactScope: Screenshot and temporary build paths record local QA artifacts; they are not shipped assets or public deployment URLs.
